subject: Aligning roadmap demo windows + recording consent (Renewal/Expansion)
messages:
From: Melissa Carter <melissa@healthspan.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@healthspan.com>
Date: Thu, 10 May 2028 09:14:00 -0400
Subject: Roadmap demo + procurement / recording question for renewal week

Hi Aditya —

Hope you’re well. We’re lining up our renewal/expansion QBR for HealthSpan (contract RF-4821) and want to schedule a consolidated roadmap demo for the execs + product and procurement teams. A couple of asks on our side:

- Can you share a 3–4 hour half-day window (preferably PST mornings) that includes a 45-min product walkthrough, a 45-min tech deep-dive (optional breakout), and a 30-min procurement/Q&A?
- Can Redwood record the product walkthrough? Procurement needs explicit recording consent documented.
- We may need a short SOW draft for procurement to speed the internal approval — can you provide a starting doc?

Proposed week: May 22–26. Do you have availability then? If you can send a couple of alternate windows, we’ll coordinate with internal stakeholders (Tom + procurement).

Thanks — appreciate a quick confirmation so I can lock rooms and invite folks.

Best,
Melissa Carter
Senior Customer Success Manager
HealthSpan

[Attachment: placeholder — none attached in this initial note]

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Melissa Carter <melissa@healthspan.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 May 2028 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Roadmap demo + procurement / recording question for renewal week

Melissa — thanks for the clear asks. We can absolutely run a consolidated half-day and record the walkthrough, but we do need explicit attendee consent recorded in the invite and a signed DPA before recordings are shared with external parties.

Available windows (PST mornings) for May 22–26:
- Tue May 23: 09:00–13:00
- Wed May 24: 08:30–12:30
- Thu May 25: 09:30–13:30 (prefers this if you want more overlap with east-coast execs)

Draft structure I suggest (attached: agenda_v2.pdf):
- 09:00–09:15 Intro + objectives (exec owners)
- 09:15–10:00 Product roadmap + feature walkthrough (recorded)
- 10:00–10:15 Break
- 10:15–11:00 Technical deep-dive (breakout for engineering)
- 11:00–11:15 Break
- 11:15–11:45 Procurement / commercial Q&A (SOW + pricing notes)
- 11:45–12:00 Next steps / roll-forward plan

I’m attaching the proposed agenda (agenda_v2.pdf) and a generic SOW starter (SOW_draft_v1.pdf) for procurement to review. Laura, Tessa — can you confirm recording policy language and whether we need to embed consent in the calendar invite? Marcus — will you own the breakout tech session?

Melissa — if one of those windows works, I’ll send the calendar hold with the recording consent language and link the DPA/documents you need.

Cheers,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

[Attachments: agenda_v2.pdf (2 pages), SOW_draft_v1.pdf (docx stub)]

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Melissa Carter <melissa@healthspan.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 May 2028 10:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Roadmap demo + procurement / recording question for renewal week

Thanks for the agenda — quick ops note from the event side.

- Recording: we can record the product walkthrough segment and store the file behind the customer portal, but HealthSpan procurement must sign/return our standard DPA (I attached recording_policy.pdf with the exact language). We also require a one-line consent clause in the calendar invite: "By joining you consent to being recorded for internal use and for the provisioning of product evaluation materials."
- Breakouts: Marcus, we should split the technical deep-dive into two 25-min tracks (infra + integration). That keeps exec time tight and gives engineers focused content.
- Accessibility & transcription: if you want captions/transcripts included we can add that (30–45 min turnaround). Let me know and I’ll add to the run-of-show.

Aditya — I’ll prepare the calendar invite text once Melissa confirms the slot and whether procurement will sign the DPA this week.

Tessa Morgan
Program Manager, Customer Events | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: recording_policy.pdf]

Aditya / Tessa — great, thanks. We’ll take Thu May 25: 09:30–13:30 PST. Tom (procurement) confirmed he can sign the DPA this week — I’ve asked him to e-sign the DocuSign you sent previously.

Two quick asks before you send the invite:
1) Can you add a 10-min window at the end for "contracting tide-check" so procurement can call out any missing commercial items?
2) We need the SOW draft to reference the renewal term language (12-month baseline + optional 12-month renewal). I included Tom on this thread so he can flag any redlines.

I signed off on the recording consent language below — please include it verbatim in the calendar invite. Once Tom returns the DPA I’ll accept the calendar hold and distribute it to our execs.

Recording consent (approved): "Attendees acknowledge that a portion of this event will be recorded. Recordings will be stored securely and shared only with named HealthSpan stakeholders after a signed DPA is in place."

Link to DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/r/ABC12345
Drive folder (agenda + SOW): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cAgendaLink

See you on May 25 — I’ll confirm attendee list once procurement completes the DPA.

Best,
Melissa Carter
Senior Customer Success Manager
HealthSpan
